ogTitle: Where to Stay in Maenam, Koh Samui
ogDesc: The best hotels in Maenam by budget.
intro: Maenam is the beach for travellers who want Koh Samui at a slow pace, not the buzz of Chaweng or Bophut. The sand runs about 7km, the water is calm, and there's a Maenam Walking Street every Thursday, local restaurants at fair prices, and ferry piers (Nathon and Pralarn) for boats to Koh Phangan, which sits clearly across the water. Stays range from small hilltop hotels with sea views to beachfront bungalow resorts and 5-star pool villas. Two things to know: the seabed drops off quickly in places, so small children should stay near the shore with an adult, and the area has no real public transport, so you'll mostly rely on a rental, taxis, or hotel shuttles. Chaweng and the airport are about a 20-25 minute drive away.

blocks.html: Short answer: Maenam is one of the quietest, best-value beaches on Koh Samui's north coast, with a simple fishing-village feel. It suits travellers who want real rest and families. Most stays are mid-priced beachfront resorts, with a few 5-star options. Prices run from under ฿1,000 to well into five figures a night.

items.name: Amarin Samui Hotel
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · Koh Phangan views · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel of about 46 rooms on a low hill at the end of Maenam Beach. The standout is a rooftop pool looking out to sea toward Koh Phangan, with the beach about a 5-minute walk down. Reviews praise the view and the caring staff, though to be honest the building is showing its age and some rooms are on the dark side. A fit for couples or solo travellers on a budget who value the view over a brand-new room.

items.name: Maenam Villa Hotel
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Beachfront · simple and good value · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small property sitting right on Maenam Beach, a few steps from the sand, with a private beach area, free parking, and water-sports facilities. The rooms are simple rather than fancy, but you get a seafront spot at a still-reachable price. A fit for couples or small families who want to wake up to the sea without paying big-resort rates and aren't fussy about a full list of amenities.

items.name: Coco Palm Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Families · quiet and peaceful · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A beachfront bungalow resort of 71 rooms in leafy grounds, with a poolside bar, a sea-view restaurant, and golf carts to get you around. Reviews score it around 4/5 and call it quiet, with calm water out front and a good breakfast. A fit for families and couples who want a laid-back rest. The trade-off is that parts of the resort are dated, though the gardens and cleanliness still earn steady praise.

items.name: The Cosy Maenam Beach Resort
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Families · seafront bungalows · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small boutique resort on Maenam Beach with beachfront and garden-view bungalows, a pool, a bar, and a restaurant. Reviews praise the seafront location, attentive staff, and cleanliness, and several families mention booking a beachfront villa for four that worked out well. A fit for travellers who want a calm, private feel with the sand right outside the room.

items.name: Khwan Beach Resort - Pool Villas and Glamping - Adults Only
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Adults only · pool villas and glamping · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An adults-only boutique art-gallery resort (guests 14 and over), about 50m from Maenam Beach. The draw is private pool villas and luxury glamping tents in a contemporary Thai style, with in-villa spa treatments and artwork throughout. Reviews score it around 8.6 and praise the privacy and service. A fit for couples or honeymooners who want quiet and a stay with a design identity that stands apart.

items.name: Santiburi Koh Samui
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Families · wide private beach · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: One of Samui's first 5-star resorts, set on a wide stretch of Maenam Beach, with 84 villas and 12 suites in expansive tropical gardens, a pool, and several restaurants. There's an 18-hole golf course on the hills nearby. Reviews praise the warm staff, the lovely private beach, and the breakfast. A fit for families and couples who want plenty of space and high-end service in a quiet part of the island.

items.name: W Koh Samui
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Private-pool villas · special occasions · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A design-forward luxury resort from the W brand, with 74 villas, each with its own private pool and island views. It has a private beach, the AWAY Spa, a gym, and several bars and restaurants including the beachfront Woobar. Reviews score it high at around 4.7/5, praising the service and breakfast. A fit for couples or anyone marking a special occasion. The trade-offs are the high price and a few guests noting some facilities are starting to age.

faq.q: Is Maenam good for families with small children?
faq.a: It works well in that the beach is quiet, safe-feeling, and uncrowded, with family-friendly beachfront resorts like Coco Palm, The Cosy, and Santiburi. But note the seabed drops off quickly in places, so small children should stay near the shore with an adult at all times. If you want genuinely shallow water for very young kids, some families lean mainly on the resort pool.

faq.q: Is it easy to get to Chaweng or the airport from Maenam?
faq.a: Maenam has no real public transport, so getting around mostly means a rental, songthaew, taxis, a ride-hailing app, or hotel shuttles. Chaweng and Samui Airport are about a 20-25 minute drive, and Fisherman's Village in Bophut is roughly 10-15 minutes. If you plan to head out often, renting a scooter or car is far more convenient and better value.

faq.q: What is there to do in Maenam besides the beach?
faq.a: The main draws are the Maenam Walking Street every Thursday with food and goods at local prices, small village restaurants and cafes, an 18-hole golf course on the hills, and ferry piers for a day trip across to Koh Phangan. If you want more restaurants and bars, Fisherman's Village in Bophut and Chaweng are a short drive away. But Maenam's appeal is its quiet, so anyone after nightlife may find it too sleepy.
